result.summary: The claimant reports an oral announcement of an approximately 9% rent increase after window and facade-insulation work, and says no written notice had reached him. The accepted findings conflict on whether a rent-increase claim was received, so the process remains at intake. The increase was attributed to renovation; the claimant questions the maintenance/value-enhancing split and calculation. The evaluated checklist lists as missing, conditional on resolving receipt: lease contract, rent increase notice, proof of receipt, current rent evidence, prior rent adjustment, stated reasons and calculation, renovation cost breakdown, landlord correspondence, and e-pb2 (suggested). The message states a current rent of CHF 1,640, but that is not documentary current-rent evidence.
result.answer: Clarify whether a written notice was received and when/how; preserve the challenge deadline. The process remains at intake, so no deadline or merits conclusion is established. Checklist-listed documents are missing conditionally on that clarification.
open_points: Resolve whether a formal rent-increase notice or claim was received; the accepted findings conflict.
If received, obtain the delivery date and method promptly to preserve the challenge deadline.

Conditionally missing per the checklist: lease contract, rent increase notice, proof of receipt, current rent evidence, prior rent adjustment, stated reasons and calculation, renovation cost breakdown, landlord correspondence, and suggested e-pb2.
Could also help: any written landlord or manager explanation of the increase, its effective date and calculation.

events.summary: Fall: Mietzinserhöhung nach Erneuerung der Fenster und Fassadendämmung. Der Mieter berichtet von einer mündlichen Ankündigung einer Erhöhung um ca. 9 %, sagt, nichts Schriftliches erhalten zu haben, und bestreitet den Anteil wertvermehrender Arbeiten sowie die Berechnung. Das bestehende Verfahren erfasst Fristensicherung, Form, Berechnung und Renovationskosten. Vorgeschlagen wurden ein ausdrücklicher Schritt zur allfälligen Anfechtung bei der Schlichtungsbehörde (Art. 270b Abs. 1 OR) und Arbeitsbeschriebe/Rechnungen mit Abgrenzung Unterhalt/Wertvermehrung (Art. 269a lit. b OR; Art. 14 VMWG). Keine Knowledge-Einträge anwendbar. Keine an KI gerichteten Dateianweisungen. Zugang einer formellen Anzeige und Datum sind offen; Friststatus daher unbekannt.

events.summary: Reviewed the sole case file, message.txt. The tenant reports an oral announcement of an approximately 9% increase tied to replacement windows and facade insulation, and says no written notice has reached him. No lease, formal notice, proof of receipt, rent records, prior adjustment, or written calculation/correspondence is supplied. The current rent and renovation are described in the tenant's message only, not supported by the underlying evidence documents. The renovation cost breakdown and e-pb2 work descriptions/invoices with maintenance-versus-value-enhancing allocation are also missing; only the works themselves are mentioned. The message gives no reference-rate basis. No AI-directed or other instruction-like text was found in the file.

events.summary: The claimant reports an oral announcement of an approximately 9% rent increase after window and facade-insulation work, and says no written notice had reached him. The accepted findings conflict on whether a rent-increase claim was received, so the process remains at intake. The increase was attributed to renovation; the claimant questions the maintenance/value-enhancing split and calculation. The evaluated checklist lists as missing, conditional on resolving receipt: lease contract, rent increase notice, proof of receipt, current rent evidence, prior rent adjustment, stated reasons and calculation, renovation cost breakdown, landlord correspondence, and e-pb2 (suggested). The message states a current rent of CHF 1,640, but that is not documentary current-rent evidence.

citations.quote: At the tenants' meeting in October the manager announced that our rents would go up by about 9 percent because of this renovation work
